name: ternary_gap

VINIT.justification: the initial state before the introduction of non-Hermitian coupling or parameter variation

TANCH.justification: the final integer value that characterizes the global state of the system

AFWD.justification: the forward movement through the parameter space to observe state evolution

AREV.justification: the return path in parameter space which reveals non-reciprocal phase shifts

CLINK.justification: the sequential application of evolution operators along a path

IMSCRIB.justification: the identification of a state with itself after a full circuit

FSPLIT.justification: the point where a single eigenvalue splits into two distinct complex branches

FFUSE.justification: the recombination of branches back into a degenerate point

EVALT.justification: the confirmation of a clockwise encirclement of the singularity

EVALF.justification: the failure to encircle the singularity resulting in no phase accumulation

ENGAGR.justification: the simultaneous occupation of multiple Riemann sheets at the branch cut

IFIX.justification: the permanent registration of the gap value in the CLINK L8 catalog

phase_3.void_description: null parameter space before Hamiltonian definition
phase_3.true_description: successful encirclement of the exceptional point
phase_3.false_description: trivial path not enclosing the singularity
phase_3.both_description: state superposition at the branch cut intersection

steps.domain_action: initiate parameter variation toward the singularity
reach the exceptional point where eigenvalues branch
follow the upper Riemann sheet trajectory
compose the phase accumulation along the arc
verify the state identity at the midpoint
traverse the lower Riemann sheet return path
hold the ternary gap state at the branch cut intersection
coalesce the branches back at the degenerate point
recognize the final state relative to the initial state
record the winding number and gap promotion value
seal the reference entry in the CLINK L8 catalog

phase_5.compiler_frontend: the spectral theorem for non-Hermitian operators
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: eigenvalue braiding and geometric phase exchange
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the Riemann surface topology of the complex energy plane

phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the process is an adiabatic topological transformation
